makepad.origin: hard fork of the local reference tree ref/makepad-dev (Makepad, declared version 2.0.0); upstream git commit unknown, no VCS metadata was present
makepad.license: MIT (makepad/LICENSE, Makepad B.V.); font licenses in makepad/widgets/resources/FONT-LICENSES.md
makepad.import_rule: cargo tree closure of the wasm32 example plus the cargo-makepad host closure; non-web backends, studio, apps, examples, xr and libs outside the closure were not imported
excluded_on_import: widgets/fonts (font crates outside the closure; widgets/resources already holds one copy of each font)
manifest_edits_on_import: platform/Cargo.toml: removed linux, android and windows target dependency tables whose path dependencies were not imported
platform/video/Cargo.toml: removed the cfg(windows) dependency table
makepad.fingerprint_algorithm: sha256 of each file as received from the reference tree; later edits are ordinary commits and show up as drift in `cargo xtask sources verify`

reference_tree_diff.method: cargo vendor of leptos 0.8.20 (csr) diffed file by file against the reference tree, ignoring manifests, checksums, tests, examples and docs

leptos: src/lib.rs (nightly cfg_attr, nonce feature gate, prefetch try_write)

reference_tree_diff.conclusion: The reference tree carries post-release changes in islands/hydration, forms, async derived, stores and macro internals. None of the files behind the verified facts (mount_to and UnmountHandle, signal/effect scheduling, the fixed DOM renderer) differ, and no Leptos source needs modification, so the crates.io release stays the locked source. Any future need to modify Leptos switches to a 0.9.0-beta hard fork per ADR-2.

vendor.name: nouislider
vendor.origin: npm registry tarball nouislider-15.8.1.tgz, obtained with `npm pack nouislider@15.8.1`
vendor.purpose: the one fixed-version third-party DOM component P1 verifies: it has real initialization and teardown, so rebuilding it can be checked for duplicate instances and duplicate subscriptions
vendor.import_rule: dist/nouislider.min.mjs and dist/nouislider.min.css only; the TypeScript sources, the UMD build and the type declarations were not imported

rust_ui.origin: ref/ui-main, the Rust/UI reference tree; it carries no VCS metadata, so there is no upstream commit to record
rust_ui.license: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Max Wells; reproduced in crates/rustify-components/LICENSE-RUST-UI
rust_ui.import_rule: only the files listed here. Each is imported verbatim in one commit and rewritten in the next, so what the fork changes reads as a diff. `state` is `verbatim` while our copy is byte-identical to what was received and `rewritten` once it is not; `sha256` is the digest of what was received either way, so provenance survives the rewrite.
rust_ui.not_imported: use_scroll_lock.rs, public/app_components/*.js, style/Animate.css, style/highlight_code.css, and the components outside the eighteen categories (charts, date_picker, carousel, sonner, data_grid, drag_and_drop, accordion, sheet, drawer, hover_card, popover, command, menubar, context_menu and the rest). The four overlay components that are imported - dialog, select, dropdown_menu, tooltip - arrive with their inline <script> and are rewritten onto the SDK's overlay stack; the script is what the rewrite removes, not what the import skips.

rewrite.clx.rs: kept clx! and void!; dropped transition! (a view-transition name it computed and never used) and with it utils.rs, which nothing else needed; the generated components now take a test_id and pass it as data-testid; the module no longer re-exports leptos's prelude, paste and tw_merge into its callers
rewrite.variants.rs: the href arm no longer calls leptos_router::hooks::use_location; a link asks this crate for the current path and marks itself aria-current=page when the path is at or below its own, on a segment boundary. The four overlapping arms became two that generate a component (plain and link) plus two that generate only the types, with the component arms delegating to the type arms instead of repeating them. Generated components take a test_id.
rewrite.not_changed: the class-string semantics, the TwClass/TwVariant derives, the default-is-the-first-arm rule, and data-name
rewrite.the eighteen categories: Every class string carries the `rui` prefix, so a host page's unprefixed utilities and ours are different classes. Every control is controlled: the value comes from the application and a user action is a request, which is what Switch, Tabs and RadioGroup did not have - each held its own state and could not report a change. `disabled` and `read_only` are signals on all of them; a read-only control takes the click and puts itself back. Every `style=` attribute is gone (a static one is written with setAttribute and a strict policy refuses it); Progress uses the `style:` directive instead. The `icons` dependency is gone with its `leptos/nightly` requirement, and so are `strum` and `validator`; icon.rs is ours. Checkbox and Radio became the browser's own controls under a drawn box rather than a `<button role=checkbox>`, so the keyboard and form participation are the platform's.
rewrite.the four that float: dialog, select, dropdown_menu (menu.rs) and tooltip arrived with 1,700 lines that included `format!`-built inline `<script>` doing the measuring, the flipping, the outside-click and the Escape key, plus `document.currentScript` and a `window.ScrollLock` global. All of it is gone: they are layers on the SDK's overlay stack (P1 M4), which owns anchoring, the Escape order, the focus trap and the return of focus. What was kept is the look. What was added is the part they never had: role=dialog with aria-modal and a title the dialog is labelled by, role=menu/menuitem with the arrow keys, combobox/listbox/option with aria-activedescendant, and role=tooltip attached to the control it describes on focus as well as on hover.
rewrite.slider.css: every selector moved under `[data-rustify-scope]` and onto `data-name`; it selected `input[type=range]` bare, which restyles the host page's own range controls (F28, and what V1's host-control comparison fails on). The second thumb variant and the `--slider-track` variable no token table defined are dropped; the box-shadow that paints the filled track is kept.
